snippet.title: Strikeforce 2004
snippet.description:
This is the first teaser Video of Strikeforce 2004, a free realworld modifikation of UT2004. The mod is beeing produced by a new Team and brought back to the roots. Strikeforcee was originally a mod for UT99 and had a great comunity, after beeing converted to UT2k4 we now rebuild what was once the best FPS mod on that engine.
This video wasnt made by me, but i think it deserves to be shown.

Feel Free to visit www.strikeforcemod.com for download and leave comments.
